comment: Real-WAV smoke set for detection-stage changes.  Each entry's `expected_messages` is the BASELINE — what the current MAP144 pipeline decodes on this WAV.  Treat it as a regression-catch reference, not an absolute truth.  When intentionally changing detection-stage behaviour, re-run, compare, and update this file with the new baseline.  Per project lesson 2026-05-15: synthetic balanced-MSK does NOT cover combine-rule failure modes; this set must include real signals with CW interferer / asymmetric multipath / noise-only.
